title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to get the Month Name/Text from a date (Two ways)
summary: The post explains three methods to extract the month name from a date in Business Central: using the Format() method with date format codes, querying the Date virtual table (ID 2000000007), and using new Date methods available in BC25.
key_points: Format() method with '<Month Text>' format code extracts full or abbreviated month names from any date
Date virtual table provides Period Name field containing month names based on period type
New Date/Time methods in BC25 allow simple month extraction using built-in functions
Each approach suits different scenarios: formatting for display, virtual table for complex date logic, new methods for simplicity

quotes.text: The Date virtual table (ID 2000000007) in Business Central gives you easy access to days, weeks, months, quarters, and years.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability of the Date virtual table for date period operations

quotes.text: we can just use Format(Rec."Posting Date", 0, '<Month Text>').
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the simplest Format() syntax for extracting month names from dates
